summary: Build practical WMS skills in inventory control, fulfillment, and reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course and plan your training.
lede: WMS training helps warehouse supervisors, inventory controllers, and logistics professionals connect system transactions with physical stock movement. At foundation level, it covers receiving and put-away workflows, inventory and replenishment controls, and picking, dispatch, and exception handling, with practice mapping processes, using GS1 identifiers, and reviewing operational measures.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level WMS course suits people who configure, supervise, analyse, or depend on warehouse inventory and fulfillment processes. It is designed for roles that need to connect system transactions with physical stock movement, order priorities, and warehouse performance.
audience: Supply chain managers using WMS reports
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: Basic familiarity with warehouse or inventory operations is useful. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use sample transaction records and do not require access to a live WMS.
